Detailed Description

Pure translations between the submitter, mqss protocol and mqss-ci enumerations: status, optimisation level, and wire-format decoding.

The tables themselves are private to src/ConstantsMapping.cpp; these functions are the whole interface. Task/compiler/backend circuit-format admission policy lives in CircuitFormatPolicy.h instead – that is policy, not translation.

No QDMI type appears here. QDMI translation belongs to MQSS-Submitter, behind its Client/Device/Job interface, which is what keeps QDMI out of every QRM&CI public header.

◆ getCompilerOptimizationLevel()

std::expected< mqss::mqssci::OptLevel, Error > mqss::qrmci::getCompilerOptimizationLevel ( int level)
nodiscard

Translate a task's requested optimisation level into the matching mqss-ci compiler optimisation level.

0 and 1 both select O1 – proto3's implicit zero for an omitted field must not be mistaken for a request to maximize optimisation.

Parameters
levelThe optimisation level requested on the QuantumTask.
Returns
The matching mqss::mqssci::OptLevel, or a CompilationFailed error naming level if it is outside 0-3.

◆ mapProtoCircuitFormat()

mqss::CircuitFormat mqss::qrmci::mapProtoCircuitFormat ( int format)
nodiscardnoexcept

Translate a raw circuit-format value received over the wire into a mqss::CircuitFormat.

protobuf preserves unknown enum values as their raw integer, so a peer built against a newer protocol can hand us an enumerator this build does not know; this is the only supported way to turn such a value into a mqss::CircuitFormat.

Parameters
formatThe raw circuit-format value as carried in the message.
Returns
The matching mqss::CircuitFormat, or mqss::CircuitFormat::CIRCUIT_FORMAT_UNSPECIFIED if format is not a known enumerator.

◆ toQrmciError()

Error mqss::qrmci::toQrmciError ( Error::Kind kind,
const mqss::submitter::Error & error )
nodiscard

Wrap a submitter failure as a QRM&CI failure of a kind the caller names.

The submitter's ErrorCode is deliberately generic – it cannot distinguish a refused submission from a device fault – so the caller, which knows what it was trying to do, supplies the Kind. This function only formats the detail: the error code's own name followed by the submitter's message.

Parameters
kindThe QRM&CI error kind this failure should carry.
errorThe submitter error to wrap.
Returns
A QRM&CI error of kind kind, detailing error.
